empty.loadInboundDesc: Upload Excel or fetch inbound records via API to view volume trends and efficiency analysis.
empty.step1: Inbound only: daily volume first; sorting efficiency auto-calculates when scanner columns are present. Multiple files/API pulls merge; duplicate waybills keep the earliest scan.
empty.step2: Add attendance: unlocks open-day and overall efficiency.
empty.step3: Dates auto-match: attendance dates align to inbound file dates.

section.dailyVolumeDesc: Left: daily summary (Cainiao tickets & share: waybill starts with 3). Right: total volume trend only. Files merge with global waybill dedupe before daily stats; open/overall efficiency rules unchanged.
section.personHoursDesc: Per-person totals in the stats window (including attendance-only days): hours, active days, open-day participation. Scan count matches Level-1 sorting personal totals; on-duty efficiency = scans ÷ total hours. Scanner matches attendance nickname case-insensitively; multi-segment codes (e.g. ADL-DC-Serene) use the last segment. Shows — when unmatched.
section.warehouseDisabledDesc: No recognizable attendance uploaded; cannot compute hour-based efficiency.
section.warehouseDisabledBody: Upload attendance CSV (date + person required; prefer Work Hours, else Total Hours) to enable this tab.
section.sortingDailyDesc: Daily scanner scan count and inferred effective hours; compare with summary and hourly tables below. Chart shows daily efficiency (parcels/hour).
section.sortingDisabledDesc: Inbound file works for open/overall efficiency but missing required sorting columns.
section.sortingDisabledBody: Required columns: scan time / waybill / scanner.
section.sortingDisabledHint: Personal efficiency restores automatically when all three columns are recognized.
section.rulesDesc: Business rules as configured, with unified multi-file and cross-day handling.
section.rulesOpenEfficiency: Open-day efficiency = uploaded volume ÷ open-day attendance hours in window.
section.rulesOverallEfficiency: Overall efficiency = uploaded volume ÷ all attendance hours in window (incl. non-open and delivery-only days).
section.rulesWindow: Stats window = earliest inbound date ~ max(latest inbound, latest attendance on/after earliest inbound).
section.rulesDailyTable: Daily table adds non-open days with no inbound in window (volume 0, still shows sorters & hours). Denominator sums by day in window. Person table is attendance-only, no per-parcel allocation.
section.rulesCainiao: Cainiao (waybill starts with 3): structural observation only; excluded from open/overall efficiency.
section.efficiencyDetailComboDesc: Blue bars: total volume (left axis); green area: sorter count (separate scale); orange line: daily efficiency (right axis).
section.efficiencyDetailWeekDesc: Each row summarizes one week; click to expand daily detail. Chart keeps daily curves with week background bands.
section.efficiencyDetailStackedDesc: Daily inbound–attendance match; combo chart below shows volume, sorters, and daily efficiency.
section.efficiencyDetailSideDesc: Daily inbound–attendance match; combo chart on the right shows volume, sorters, and daily efficiency.
section.scannerTotalEffDesc: Total-efficiency calculation differs by scanner role
